generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster with a limited red-toned palette on a cream background depicts a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, and a banana under a stormy night sky with lightning and abundant mist. The central subject is a stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous pink donut, appearing weightless, with holographic icing, from which two female legs clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes emerge. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other holding a glass pipe. Dripping from the donut's base is pink liquid and white spilled milk, and it's adorned with numerous diamonds and pink sprinkles. To the left, an eggplant holds a glowing syringe, and to the right, a banana also holds a glowing syringe. At the top, in a mid-century serif font, is the bold headline "YO PAS CL SLM FF" arched across in all caps, with "TU VRGN SLM ACT" as a tagline below it. A few mid-century sparkle and starburst icons are scattered around the headline.
